current_milestone: VAE Phase A native REA tendency modification live smoke preparation

human_workflows.ordinary_capture: Human explicitly tells Gemini to capture; FULL does not need a newly completed match; model waits for Human completion notice.
human_workflows.write_safety_smoke: After explicit authorized write, Human simulates one week, tells Gemini to FULL capture, then notifies planner; planner validates immediate and subsequent readbacks and any game override.
human_workflows.mechanism_effect: After Phase A success, Human simulates requested N days and explicitly triggers Gemini capture; analyze post-intervention games and controls.
human_workflows.nonnegotiable: No agent self-advances game, self-triggers human capture, polls in background or assumes a Human action completed.

data_policy: Local-only large SQLite, WAL, SHM, raw memory and compressed DB backup; GitHub code/schemas/sanitized light evidence; no retroactive history rewrite.
loop_policy: Bounded evidence-yielding internal iterations; distinguish pre-delivery rounds from post-delivery remediation (max 2); keep Canonical Core workflow/Human gates.
immediate_successor_action: Ask whether Gemini already received/finished the REA Phase A local tool READ-ONLY preflight; if report exists inspect it, otherwise prepare/dispatch preflight only. Do not authorize setter or game operation.
stop_if: No Human authorization, mismatched save, unknown REA IDs, missing native binding/build, or unknown preflight state.
evidence_rank: Human first-hand current gameplay facts > raw verified receipts > code/tests > developer textual summaries > hypotheses
